basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old software engineer based in Seattle with a keen interest in open-source software and Linux distributions. When I'm not coding, I enjoy exploring the vibrant arcade scene in my city and am an avid participant in Les Mills fitness programs, which keep me active. I'm also deeply interested in genealogy, particularly Jewish family history, which often leads me to the JewishNames subreddit. My typical online hours are in the evenings, as I balance a full-time job with my hobbies. Recently single, I'm focusing on personal growth and expanding my knowledge base.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington, I have spent the last decade working in tech, mostly in software development and IT support roles. My interest in Linux started in college, and I've since become proficient in various distributions through self-learning and professional experience.
